Labor as % of Suggested Price (should be 45–60%)

Notes:
• Labor cost is your single biggest lever — keep it around 45–60% of the final price.
• Post-construction, carpet, upholstery and fumigation are specialty work — price them at the top of the guide, not the bottom.
• Only pay your team after the client pays (per your own rule) — this calculator shows target profit, not cash-flow timing.
• Update the Monthly Overhead and Average Jobs/Month figures periodically as Aura grows.
